name: nextjs-stack
description: Next.js + Supabase + Vercel stack, 0.1.0, an early release: conventions for how the three fit together, and the stack's markers for the stack detector. feature/fix/review still lean on the Rails-flavoured agents. Platform knowledge stays in Vercel's official plugin (vercel-plugin) and Supabase's supabase/agent-skills, which it points to rather than copies.
